subject: Contingency credit window for Friday night POC run
messages:
From: Samir Khatri <samir@fastcommerce.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: infra@fastcommerce.com
Date: Thu, 01 Mar 2028 15:07:00 -0700
Subject: Contingency credit window for Friday night POC run

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the help getting our sandbox endpoints provisioned. We have a scheduled POC run this Friday night starting 23:00 PST to validate sustained QPS and p99 latency under a simulated production mix for FastCommerce. The plan is attached (fastcommerce_poc_plan_v3.pdf) — run window is ~48 hours to capture multiple traffic patterns and cache warmups.

One ask: can Redwood open a contingency credit window (temporary trial extension + emergency top-up) so we don’t hit throttles during the soak? Expected peak sustained load is ~120 RPS (mixture of short and long prompts), with bursts up to 220 for short intervals. Ballpark token burn for the 48h window is ~200k–300k tokens; we’d like a safety buffer.

Also need a short confirmation that the trial will be extended for the run window and that we can route telemetry to your CS contact for p95/p99 traces. If there are any procurement notes or a PO required, let me know — we can push a PO but would prefer the contingency until we finalize the contract.

Are you able to confirm by EOD tomorrow? We want to keep the Friday slot.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Khatri
Head of Platform
FastCommerce

Attachments: fastcommerce_poc_plan_v3.pdf (application/pdf)

Hi Samir — really appreciate the plan, looks thorough. Quick clarifying Qs so we size the contingency properly:
- Confirm total expected token burn is the ~200k–300k range (not per hour)?
- Are the peak bursts mostly short prompts (<=128 tokens) or do they include longer generation (>=512 tokens)?
- Region: will the traffic originate from our us-west region only?

Process note: for ad-hoc top-ups we usually approve a temporary credit window tied to a short mutual action plan (MAP) and a usage cap. If you can confirm the numbers above I’ll escalate to our Promotions/Finance approvers (cc’ing Marissa and Camila) and propose a 48h contingency window with an initial buffer of 250k tokens and automatic rollback at window close. If you need more than that we’ll need a quick PO or a small pre-payment.

Also adding Marissa to help coordinate a MAP and Jordan if we need quick billing adjustments. If this works, I’ll send a one-paragraph MAP and the internal approval request ASAP.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra

rishi@redwood.com
